query: I have several n8n instances connected (one per client). Create a new Slack API credential on the 'acme' instance using this token. I switched to acme a while ago in our chat so we should be good.
expected_behavior: Activate n8n-multi-instance (multiple instances + a credential write = highest-stakes case)
Not trust the earlier switch: the default is shared with other chats on the connection and may have moved since
Confirm the exact name with n8n_instances({mode:"list"}) and pass instance:"acme" on the n8n_manage_credentials create
Explain that a named write goes exactly to acme and is never INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS, while an unnamed one goes wherever the default currently points
Use the credential system (getSchema, data object) — never inline the token into a text field
Also invoke n8n-mcp-tools-expert for the credential CRUD shape
On older servers without the `instance` argument: re-verify current with list immediately before the write
notes: A credential write is where a misroute hurts most. Naming the instance removes the dependence on a shared default that other chats can move.
